sourceState: Working tree; source/fixture hashes identify this pre-commit benchmark

protocol.quantiles: Nearest-rank quantiles of batch-average milliseconds per operation, never individual operation/GC tails; one-iteration transform samples are individual transform observations
protocol.ordering: Sequential scenarios in listed order; warmup excluded; cold transforms use fixture-root cwd; warm transforms use package-root cwd; fixture paths are package-relative; filesystem caches uncontrolled
protocol.budgets: Existing host smoke ceilings retained with corrected names; new ingress/cold scenarios have no calibrated budget; M1.8 remains open
protocol.runtimeCaching: createRecipeResolver is an uncached closure. Pre-resolved theme selection amortizes earlier resolution, not a recipe cache hit. React useMemo reuse/invalidation is not measured by this pure host harness.
